notes: Sourced from the EPO Schedule-of-Fees SPA's backing BFF (https://fees.apps.epo.org/prod/bff/api/fees). The BFF is undocumented but stable. Renewal years 2-20 covered by codes 732-750; the parallel 752-770 series is the 'additional fee' (late-payment surcharge) for the same year. Codes 100-110 are additional fees for the IP5 sharing renewal calculation. Amounts converted from European notation ('1.595,00' → 1595.00).
